spans.s:
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Auspicious, fortunate.
E.
श्वेस and वस both particles implying auspiciousness, ईयसुन् affixed to the latter, and a final vowel added to the compound.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Self-got, self-acquired, (as wealth, &c.)
E.
स्व self, उपार्जित obtained.

m. (-सः)
Sediment of oil, &c. ground with a stone and muller.
